Discussion?

Oh, hey.

I’m new here. Feels good.

I haven’t left the NaNo site yet, but I’m only two days ahead. I’d like to stay there for my alternate story thing. Though, I never said that this one was what I was truly working on (mainly because Fiction is hard to classify, but also because this one does not fit my description of a story perfectly).

So, I want to know your thoughts on the following:

Why do you think that some characters are more than people to more readers?
What is the difference between a person and someone unique?
I’ve never known many people due to my circumstances, and my lack of experience as far as the readers who think this is Fantasy-Termwhatarenpeople. Are there any other people like me out there?

(Oh, and in case you were wondering, I think I am a person. Thank you. Not Nearly. Retired after a long life. Died. Actually even that was a bit of over exaggerating, so have a bit more of an image. This is a bit like a fiction-dream. I feel like I am living on two worlds.
